prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Pet Selection Redesign: Redesigns the friend picker screen to use a stage layout showcasing the desktop pet on a virtual pedestal with enhanced selection controls.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Choose the pet personality and appearance that will keep you company on your screen."}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Customization Sign-In Flow Reorder: Moves sign-in screen after pet selection and photo upload so users build emotional investment before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Custom Pet", "body": "Sign in now to lock in your pet choice and sync across your devices."}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Style Selector Screen: Adds a dedicated personality selection screen before adoption certificate generation, letting users select pet temperament options.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_personality", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_personality": {"headline": "Choose Pet Behavior Style", "body": "Pick how your pet acts on your desktop: energetic explorer, calm desk companion, or playful buddy.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select behavior trait", "action": "choose", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Confirm Traits", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Quick Actions Intro Redesign: Redesigns the home intro welcome screen into a split layout clearly highlighting desktop interaction shortcuts (hide, summon, chat).
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, chat, or access quick controls. Drag your pet anywhere on screen.", "button_label": "Start Exploring"}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Sync Guarantee Copy: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly inform returning users that existing pets will be automatically restored upon signing in.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In & Restore Your Pets", "body": "Log into your account to automatically sync and restore all your saved desktop pets and preferences."}}
5: [adoption, incentive] Custom Pet Trait Bonus Unlock Incentive: Adds a badge incentive highlight on pet selection promoting unlockable starter desktop accessories.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"hint": "Special Offer: Completing setup today unlocks bonus desktop accessories for your new companion!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Starter Accessory Bundle", "style": "playful"}]}}
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Setup Wait Info: Displays animated progress details and display setup reassurance on the waiting screen while pet assets load.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Rendering Desktop Overlay", "body": "Configuring display drivers and desktop screen bounds for seamless pet movement...", "notify_when_ready": true}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Split Layout Path Selection View: Changes path selection screen to a split layout comparing pre-made visual pets versus instant AI custom generation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "How Would You Like to Adopt?", "body": "Pick a ready-made companion from our collection or create a custom pet from your photos."}}
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Overlay Control Toast Notification: Adds an actionable hint tip on the home intro screen detailing shortcut hotkeys for hiding and revealing the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Quick Tip: Press Alt+P anytime to hide or bring your pet back to the front of your desktop.", "tip_delay_seconds": 3}}
9: [adoption, hint] Photo Generation Fallback Recovery Hint: Provides reassurance hint on photo upload explaining safe fallback options if image processing fails or stalls.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use clear, well-lit photos. If processing takes long, standard companion features will auto-apply so you won't get stuck.", "show_time_estimate": true}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns friend picker screen while maintaining its required function.
Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Adding a new personality selection screen inside onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout and copy is allowed.
Updating sign-in copy to explain pet sync is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions a special offer and bonus accessories, violating Rule 3.
Updating waiting screen details and progress indicators is allowed by Rule 4.
Redesigning path selection while retaining both adoption choices is allowed.
Adding control hints to the home intro screen is allowed.
Adding photo processing reassurance hints and time estimates is allowed.
